info.title: Reactive Resume
info.description: Reactive Resume API. Mutations do not support Idempotency-Key. Do not automatically retry POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE requests after a timeout: first read the resource to determine whether the operation succeeded. Existing enum values and response shapes are retained for compatibility.

post.summary: Parse a PDF file into resume data
post.description: Extracts structured resume data from a PDF file using the specified AI provider. The file should be sent as a base64-encoded string along with AI provider credentials. Returns a complete ResumeData object. Requires authentication.

200.description: The PDF was successfully parsed into structured resume data.

marginX.description: The horizontal margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

marginY.description: The vertical margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

format.description: The format of the page. Can be 'a4', 'letter', or 'free-form'.

locale.description: The locale of the page. Used for displaying pre-translated section headings, if not overridden.

dateFormat.description: How dates print: 'short' (Mar 2022), 'long' (March 2022), 'numeric' (03/2022) or 'iso' (2022-03). When missing, it's read from how the dates were typed.

hideLinkUnderline.description: Whether to hide the underlines of the links.

hideIcons.description: Whether to hide the item-level icons (skills, profiles, interests).

hideSectionIcons.description: Whether to hide the section heading icons displayed before section titles.

page.description: The page settings of the resume. Determines the margins, format, and locale of the resume.

icon.description: The icon to display for the custom field. Must be a valid icon name from @phosphor-icons/web icon set, or an empty string to hide. Default to '' (empty string) when unsure which icons are available.

type.description: The type of the level design. 'hidden' will hide the level design, 'circle' will display a circle, 'square' will display a square, 'rectangle' will display a rectangle, 'rectangle-full' will display a full rectangle, 'progress-bar' will display a progress bar, and 'icon' will display an icon. sidebarWidth.description: The width of the sidebar column, defined as a percentage of the page width.

sidebarSide.description: Which side of the page the sidebar column sits on in two-column templates. When unset, each template uses its own side (and right-to-left resumes mirror it).

fullWidth.description: Whether the layout of the page should be full width. If true, the main column will span the entire width of the page. This means that there should be no items in the sidebar column.

main.description: The items to display in the main column of the page. A string array of section IDs (experience, education, projects, skills, languages, interests, awards, certifications, publications, volunteer, references, profiles, summary or UUIDs for custom sections). sidebar.description: The items to display in the sidebar column of the page. pages.description: The pages to display in the layout.

layout.description: The layout of the resume. Determines the structure and arrangement of the sections on the resume.

gapX.description: The horizontal gap between the sections of the page, defined in points (pt).

gapY.description: The vertical gap between the sections of the page, defined in points (pt).

marginX.description: The horizontal margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

marginY.description: The vertical margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

format.description: The format of the page. Can be 'a4', 'letter', or 'free-form'.

locale.description: The locale of the page. Used for displaying pre-translated section headings, if not overridden.

dateFormat.description: How dates print: 'short' (Mar 2022), 'long' (March 2022), 'numeric' (03/2022) or 'iso' (2022-03). When missing, it's read from how the dates were typed.

hideLinkUnderline.description: Whether to hide the underlines of the links.

hideIcons.description: Whether to hide the item-level icons (skills, profiles, interests).

hideSectionIcons.description: Whether to hide the section heading icons displayed before section titles.

page.description: The page settings of the resume. Determines the margins, format, and locale of the resume.

icon.description: The icon to display for the custom field. Must be a valid icon name from @phosphor-icons/web icon set, or an empty string to hide. Default to '' (empty string) when unsure which icons are available.

type.description: The type of the level design. 'hidden' will hide the level design, 'circle' will display a circle, 'square' will display a square, 'rectangle' will display a rectangle, 'rectangle-full' will display a full rectangle, 'progress-bar' will display a progress bar, and 'icon' will display an icon. primary.description: The primary color of the design, defined as rgba(r, g, b, a).

text.description: The text color of the design, defined as rgba(r, g, b, a). Usually set to black: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1).

background.description: The background color of the design, defined as rgba(r, g, b, a). Usually set to white: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1).

fontSize.description: The size of the font to use, defined in points (pt).

lineHeight.description: The line height of the font to use, defined as a multiplier of the font size (e.g. 1.5 for 1.5x).

sidebarSide.description: Which side of the page the sidebar column sits on in two-column templates. When unset, each template uses its own side (and right-to-left resumes mirror it).

marginX.description: The horizontal margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

marginY.description: The vertical margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

format.description: The format of the page. Can be 'a4', 'letter', or 'free-form'.

locale.description: The locale of the page. Used for displaying pre-translated section headings, if not overridden.

dateFormat.description: How dates print: 'short' (Mar 2022), 'long' (March 2022), 'numeric' (03/2022) or 'iso' (2022-03). When missing, it's read from how the dates were typed.

hideLinkUnderline.description: Whether to hide the underlines of the links.

hideIcons.description: Whether to hide the item-level icons (skills, profiles, interests).

hideSectionIcons.description: Whether to hide the section heading icons displayed before section titles.

page.description: The page settings of the resume. Determines the margins, format, and locale of the resume.

icon.description: The icon to display for the custom field. Must be a valid icon name from @phosphor-icons/web icon set, or an empty string to hide. Default to '' (empty string) when unsure which icons are available.

type.description: The type of the level design. 'hidden' will hide the level design, 'circle' will display a circle, 'square' will display a square, 'rectangle' will display a rectangle, 'rectangle-full' will display a full rectangle, 'progress-bar' will display a progress bar, and 'icon' will display an icon. post.summary: Record a public resume PDF download
post.description: Records a visitor's explicit PDF download after the browser starts saving the file. Requires access to the public resume. For password-protected resumes, first call verifyResumePassword (POST /resumes/{username}/{slug}/password/verify) with the password, then send the returned HttpOnly resume_access_<resumeId> cookie with this request. A missing or invalid access cookie returns NEED_PASSWORD (HTTP 401); the cookie expires after 10 minutes. Owner downloads are excluded. Rate limited per resume and visitor.

delete.description: Moves a resume to Trash, which stops its public link. get.summary: Get public resume by username and slug
get.description: Returns a publicly shared resume identified by the owner's username and the resume's slug. A slug the resume had within the last 30 days still finds it; the response carries the current slug, so clients can redirect. If the resume is password-protected and the viewer has not yet verified the password, a 401 error with code NEED_PASSWORD is returned. No authentication required for public resumes; if authenticated as the owner, private resumes are also accessible.

name.description: The name of the reference, or a note such as 'Available upon request'. Empty while the entry is a draft, which isn't printed.

position.description: The position or job title of the reference.

website.description: The website or LinkedIn profile of the reference, if any.

url.description: The URL to show as a link. Must be a valid URL with a protocol (http:// or https://).

label.description: The label to display for the URL. Leave blank to display the URL as-is.

inlineLink.description: If true, the website URL is rendered as a hyperlink on the title instead of a separate link at the bottom.

phone.description: The phone number of the reference.

description.description: The description of the reference. Can be used to display a quote, a testimonial, etc. This should be a HTML-formatted string.

items.description: The items to display in the custom section. Items follow the schema of the section type.

customSections.description: Custom sections of the resume, such as a custom section for notes, etc.

template.description: The template to use for the resume. Determines the overall design and appearance of the resume.

sidebarWidth.description: The width of the sidebar column, defined as a percentage of the page width.

sidebarSide.description: Which side of the page the sidebar column sits on in two-column templates. When unset, each template uses its own side (and right-to-left resumes mirror it).

fullWidth.description: Whether the layout of the page should be full width. If true, the main column will span the entire width of the page. This means that there should be no items in the sidebar column.

main.description: The items to display in the main column of the page. A string array of section IDs (experience, education, projects, skills, languages, interests, awards, certifications, publications, volunteer, references, profiles, summary or UUIDs for custom sections). These are layout identifiers, not JSON Pointers: `summary` is stored at `/summary`, custom sections at `/customSections`, and the rest under `/sections/<id>`.

sidebar.description: The items to display in the sidebar column of the page. A string array of section IDs (experience, education, projects, skills, languages, interests, awards, certifications, publications, volunteer, references, profiles, summary or UUIDs for custom sections). These are layout identifiers, not JSON Pointers: `summary` is stored at `/summary`, custom sections at `/customSections`, and the rest under `/sections/<id>`.

pages.description: The pages to display in the layout.

layout.description: The layout of the resume. Determines the structure and arrangement of the sections on the resume.

gapX.description: The horizontal gap between the sections of the page, defined in points (pt).

gapY.description: The vertical gap between the sections of the page, defined in points (pt).

marginX.description: The horizontal margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

marginY.description: The vertical margin of the page, defined in points (pt).

format.description: The format of the page. Can be 'a4', 'letter', or 'free-form'.

locale.description: The locale of the page. Used for displaying pre-translated section headings, if not overridden.

dateFormat.description: How dates print: 'short' (Mar 2022), 'long' (March 2022), 'numeric' (03/2022) or 'iso' (2022-03). When missing, it's read from how the dates were typed.

hideLinkUnderline.description: Whether to hide the underlines of the links.

hideIcons.description: Whether to hide the item-level icons (skills, profiles, interests).

hideSectionIcons.description: Whether to hide the section heading icons displayed before section titles.

page.description: The page settings of the resume. Determines the margins, format, and locale of the resume.

icon.description: The icon to display for the custom field. Must be a valid icon name from @phosphor-icons/web icon set, or an empty string to hide. Default to '' (empty string) when unsure which icons are available.

type.description: The type of the level design. 'hidden' will hide the level design, 'circle' will display a circle, 'square' will display a square, 'rectangle' will display a rectangle, 'rectangle-full' will display a full rectangle, 'progress-bar' will display a progress bar, and 'icon' will display an icon. If 'icon' is selected, the icon to display should be specified in the 'icon' field.

primary.description: The primary color of the design, defined as rgba(r, g, b, a).

text.description: The text color of the design, defined as rgba(r, g, b, a). Usually set to black: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1).

background.description: The background color of the design, defined as rgba(r, g, b, a). Usually set to white: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1).

design.description: The design settings of the resume. Determines the colors, level designs, and typography of the resume.

fontFamily.description: The family of the font to use. Must be a supported resume font.

fontWeights.description: The weight of the font, defined as a number between 100 and 900. Default to 400 when unsure if the weight is available in the font.

fontSize.description: The size of the font to use, defined in points (pt).

lineHeight.description: The line height of the font to use, defined as a multiplier of the font size (e.g. 1.5 for 1.5x).

body.description: The typography for the body of the resume.

fontFamily.description: The family of the font to use. Must be a supported resume font.

fontWeights.description: The weight of the font, defined as a number between 100 and 900. Default to 400 when unsure if the weight is available in the font.

fontSize.description: The size of the font to use, defined in points (pt).

lineHeight.description: The line height of the font to use, defined as a multiplier of the font size (e.g. 1.5 for 1.5x).

heading.description: The typography for the headings of the resume.

hyphenation.description: Enable automatic PDF hyphenation using the resume language. Defaults to false.

typography.description: The typography settings of the resume. Determines the fonts and sizes of the body and headings of the resume.

notes.description: Personal notes for the resume. Can be used to add any additional information or instructions for the resume. These notes are not displayed on the resume, they are only visible to the author of the resume when editing the resume. This should be a HTML-formatted string.

styleRules.description: Structured style rules that target semantic resume sections and slots for PDF rendering.

check.description: The author's Check choices for this resume. Not printed; missing until a choice is made.

ignored.description: Check issues the author chose to ignore, by issue key (the rule code and where it applies).

hiddenTerms.description: Job-posting terms the author hid from Job match as not true for them.

metadata.description: Metadata for the resume, such as template, layout, typography, etc. This section describes the overall design and appearance of the resume.
